card.name: Inside chemical names before oct-
card.fires_on: Hyphens, brackets and short pieces inside systematic chemical names, right where an 'octyl' or 'octane' part is likely to follow. Seen in names like tri-n-butyl phosphate, di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate and perfluorohexyloctane.
